title: tests found implementation bugs
details: - TC-PWD-1-11: expected After submitting current Factoryfake1$ and the same 101-character value (Factoryfake1$ + 88 'a') in New and Confirm, the page stays on /Manage/ChangePassword and shows 'The New password must be at least 6 and at max 100 characters long.', got The page stays on /Manage/ChangePassword but shows only 'The new password and confirmation password do not match.' (in the summary and under Confirm). No length message is shown. The rendered NewPassword input has maxlength="100", so the browser keeps 100 of the 101 characters, while ConfirmPassword has no maxlength and keeps 101. (The shopper typed the same password twice and is told the entries differ. AC4 requires the page to show what is actually wrong. Because only one of the two inputs is limited, the length error the view model defines can never be shown for input typed into the form.) at src/Identity.API/Views/Manage/ChangePassword.cshtml (NewPassword input rendered by asp-for with the [StringLength(100)] rule from Models/ManageViewModels/ChangePasswordViewModel.cs, which emits maxlength=100; the ConfirmPassword input has no maxlength)
